merchandisingData.terms:
ELIGIBLE RACES
Presque Isle Downs
Race 4
Monday, September 28th, 2026

PROMOTION TERMS

Thank you for choosing to participate in this promotion (the “Promotion”) being offered by DraftKings. By entering or participating in the Promotion you hereby agree to be bound by these Promotion terms (the “Promotion Terms,” together with the DraftKings and DK Racing Terms of Use and General Rules, the “Terms”). If you do not wish to be bound by the Promotion Terms, please do not enter or participate in the Promotion. If you have any questions regarding the Promotion or the Terms, or wish to cancel your participation in this Promotion, please contact [support@draftkings.com](mailto:support@draftkings.com) for more information.

PROMOTION AND ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

The Bet Back Promotion is valid between 09/28/2026 at 12:00 AM Eastern Time (ET) and 09/28/2026 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time (ET) (the "Promotional Period"). Must be a Resident of a jurisdiction in which DraftKings Racing operates: available in select US States, please see [https://racing.draftkings.com/where-is-draftkings-racing-available](https://racing.draftkings.com/where-is-draftkings-racing-available). Must be 18+ years of age or older (21+ in WA).

In addition to the eligibility requirements set forth above and in the DK Racing Terms & Conditions, to participate in the Promotion, customers must: (1) be a resident of a jurisdiction in which DK Racing operates and meet the minimum age requirements; (2) have a valid DK Racing account or signup for a new DK Racing account; (3) opt-in to the promotion prior to the start of the Eligible Race(s) (defined above); (4) Place a Win bet on a single horse in an Eligible Race(s) (“Qualifying Bet”) after opt-in. Your Qualifying Bet will be the first Win wager on an eligible race after opt-in.

BONUS REWARD REDEMPTION

Upon completion of a Qualifying Bet on an Eligible Race, customers will receive 100% of their stake back, up to $10 in Crown Cash, if their chosen horse does not win (win wager loses). The Promotion is only eligible on races where seven (7) or more horses run. Bets must be placed prior to the start of your selected race. Maximum reward of $10 in Crown Cash per eligible race after opt-in. Customers may bet more than $10 but are only eligible to receive a $10 Crown Cash reward. $10 paid as Crown Cash. Once the Qualifying Bet(s) have been settled, your account will be credited within 1 business day, or up to 3 calendar days if there are technical difficulties.

CROWN CASH LIMITATIONS

Crown Cash are site credits that are single-use, non-transferable, non-withdrawable, and have no cash value. Crown Cash are site credits and do not represent real world monetary value. Crown Cash is earned by placing fantasy contest entries, wagering on DraftKings Sportsbook and Casino, wagering on GNOG, or placing lottery ticket orders via Jackpocket (each a "DK Platform"). Customers can choose when to use Crown Cash, but must select Crown Cash prior to placing an entry, wager, or order on a DraftKings Platform. Entry fees, wagers, and orders cannot be split between Crown Cash and cash from your cash balance in your account wallet. Crown Cash must be played or wagered 1x prior to withdrawal of any resulting winnings. For example, a customer places a wager of $5 using Crown Cash at +100 odds on Sportsbook and wins. The $5 Crown Cash stake will be converted to $5 cash, and the customer will receive $5 in winnings for a total of $10 in withdrawable cash. For fantasy contests, the Crown Cash entry fee is not returned to the customer’s account, in the same way a cash entry fee would not be returned for a fantasy contest. Crown Cash cannot be used in combination with any other promotional credits, tokens, and/or bonuses, and may not be eligible for use on all promotions, betting markets, casino games, fantasy contests, or lottery ticket orders. Crown Cash accrued from activity on DK Platforms expires on a rolling 12-month period (“Accrual Expiration,” exactly 365 days). Customers who are inactive on DK Platforms for a period of 12 consecutive months will forfeit their platform-accrued Crown Cash balance. The Accrual Expiration period will restart as soon as a customer places an entry, wager, or order with cash from their cash balance. DraftKings play, entries, wagers, and orders accrue Crown Cash at different rates, and some actions may not accrue at all. Use of Crown Cash will not restart the Accrual Expiration period. For more information on accrual rates and DraftKings Rewards, please see: [https://www.draftkings.com/draftkings-rewards-terms](https://www.draftkings.com/draftkings-rewards-terms).

Crown Cash issued from a promotion will expire according to that promotion’s terms. CROWN CASH FROM THIS PROMOTION EXPIRES 7 DAYS (168 HOURS) AFTER BEING ISSUED. If a customer has received Crown Cash from other promotions, the Crown Cash allotment that expires first will be used first. Failure to use Crown Cash before expiration will void the reward and will not be reissued.

Crown Cash wagers on DraftKings Casino and GNOG do not contribute to leaderboards, any type of jackpot, and cannot be used for Electric Poker. Crown Cash earned on GNOG cannot be used on DraftKings and is only available for use on GNOG Casino. For more information regarding game availability and accrual rates please see: [https://dkng.co/crowncashfaq](https://dkng.co/crowncashfaq).


GENERAL TERMS

Limit one per customer per eligible race. This Promotion cannot be used in conjunction with any other offer or promotion. See the Terms for information and limitations on wagering. Excludes show and future wagers, canceled wagers and scratched runners (which will return the wager). Should you wish to cancel your participation in this Promotion at any time, please contact customer experience at [support@draftkings.com](mailto:support@draftkings.com). Upon cancellation, you may withdraw any funds deposited in connection with this Promotion subject to the Terms. All promotions are subject to the Terms and DraftKings Privacy Policy. By accepting any bonus rewards and participating in this Promotion, registered players agree to abide by the Terms. Promotional offer is subject to regulatory approval. Void where prohibited by law. DraftKings account holders are responsible for any and all applicable local, state, or federal taxes. DraftKings is not liable for computer or program malfunctions, nor for errors in bonus rewards. DraftKings reserves the right to exclude certain registered players from this Promotion, as well as the right to withhold the bonus reward if there is reason to suspect that their actions are fraudulent or, at DraftKings's sole discretion, it is determined that their actions are in violation of the Terms. To be eligible for this Promotion, players must be eligible to wager on DK Racing and must be resident of a jurisdiction in which DK Racing operates. Any player who is found to be ineligible to play on DK Racing immediately forfeits any bonus rewards which have been awarded. See the Terms for information on eligibility for creating, using, and funding an advance deposit wagering account. DraftKings reserves the right to cancel or amend this Promotion at any time without prior notice.
